principle: Saved assets accelerate discovery but never impose data size, variables, science question or operator ceiling. If relevant evidence is missing, prepare and execute an appropriately scoped new capture. A scope has bounded execution budget; a research program may expand across successively frozen scopes.

triggers: competing mechanisms unidentifiable from saved data
new source strata or independent confirmation required
motion action or downstream video discrepancy
effect heterogeneous or contrary cases require followup
new_scope_gate: identify first native producer and observable
select real independent source clusters and exposure roles
freeze model numeric backend and any GPU device layout
predeclare decision-changing comparison plus stopping rule
register exact bounded scope in ACTIVE
execute through actual native collection, verify RUN/EXIT and payload
reassess evidence and decide if a new scope is needed
need_driven_rules.statistical_unit: unique image clusters, all nested seeds/steps/blocks/tokens tracked separately
need_driven_rules.current_gpu_cap: actual available and authorized useful amount, frozen per scope, no pre-set global integer

requests.scientific_gap: All eight raw BF16 sources and twenty old UB1 video sources were historically exposed; motion/camera/action distribution and source counts cannot support independent new claims.
requests.trigger: Any source-held model selection or video/generalization claim relying only on exposed image clusters
requests.new_producer: additional independent image cluster records with image/prompt/conditioning, dataset version, scene strata, source exposure and input locator
requests.proposed_coverage: stratify true moving subject, interaction events, background, camera movement, static controls, texture/lighting; compare source-count levels 12/24/48 as possible, extend as needed; preserve new frozen confirmation
requests.controls: cluster same image across prompts/crops/seeds, Dense/candidate matched same checkpoint and initial noise
requests.acceptance_for_collection: actual source-bank with readable unique images and role/exposure proof, not only a planned manifest

actual_followthrough.history: New to seven scanned history banks, not exhaustive global history or blind confirmation; root agent input review completed
